g.text: Frequency gaps are a bin-selection effect, not a DFT-versus-FFT effect
N512 · 192 ksample/s · sqrt-Hann window · 50 Hz sweep · median of three tone phases
Same selected bins produce the same floating frequency response with either architecture. This isolates spectral retention before beamforming.
The all-bin line is the comparison denominator, not proof of a perfectly flat microphone/filter response. No noise or detection threshold is included.
